interface.name: ext_athanor_snap_manager_v1

description.summary: manage window snapping and layout zones

interface.description: This interface allows clients to request smart window snap behaviors, query snap zones, and position surface enclaves according to Athanor OS AI-driven grid layout policy.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface is already a snap surface

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the compositor that the client will no longer use the snap manager.

request.name: get_snap_surface

description.summary: create a snap surface controller for a surface

request.description: Instantiates a snap surface interface associated with the given wl_surface.

interface.name: ext_athanor_snap_surface_v1

description.summary: control snapping behavior for a specific surface

interface.description: Allows configuring snap target zones (e.g. left half, right half, top-left quadrant, center tile, custom grid region), previewing snap bounds, and committing snap layouts.

entry.name: sticky
entry.summary: keep surface snapped across workspace switches

request.name: destroy
request.description: Restores default surface behavior and frees the snap surface resource.

request.name: set_snap_zone

description.summary: assign surface to a designated snap zone

request.description: Requests the compositor to snap the window to a specified preset zone or custom region.

request.name: set_custom_region

description.summary: define custom coordinates for snap zone

request.description: Defines an exact bounding rectangle (x, y, width, height) relative to output geometry.

request.name: unset_snap
request.description: Reverts the window back to regular floating/tiled layout state.

request.name: commit_snap
request.description: Applies pending snap configuration changes atomically on the next surface commit.

event.name: zone_preview

description.summary: notify client of active snap zone preview bounds

event.description: Sent by compositor during drag operations to indicate proposed snap target geometry.

event.name: snap_applied
event.description: Sent when compositor successfully completes window snap transition.

event.name: snap_released
event.description: Sent when surface is released from snap state.
